options.title: BREAK MAKER
options.summary: A DRUM BREAK FROM THE SD CARD AS A RUNNING LOOP, LOCKED TO THE SEQUENCER: STEPS JUMP TO SLICES, ROLL AND REVERSE, PADS MANGLE IT LIVE, AND A GENERATOR WRITES NEW PATTERNS.

controls.does: ROW 1 BREAK; ROW 2 PADS (WHILE HELD), STEP TYPES; ROW 3 SLICES; ROW 4 CHARACTER, PITCH MODE, NEW PATTERN, KEEP RHYTHM, VARY, CLEAR
ON NEW PATTERN, KEEP RHYTHM, VARY OR CLEAR: UNDOES THE LAST ONE
ON BREAK MAKER TRACKS: OPENS ITS PAGE FOR THE HELD STEPS (THEIR SLICE AND STEP TYPE)
